scripts.build: bun --bun run images && bunx --bun --no-install astro build
scripts.deploy: bun --bun run build && bunx --bun --no-install wrangler deploy
scripts.dev: bun --bun run images && bunx --bun --no-install astro dev
scripts.images: bunx --bun --no-install agent-tool --repo ../.. images build favicons --out packages/website/public && bunx --bun --no-install agent-tool --repo ../.. images build social --out packages/website/public
